title: Her Sunday week check: six classes, a midterm window and ten deadlines, all inside her afternoon study routine: no push

best_fix.what: No push. At 12:50 on Sunday, the week check is ready if she opens it (one card on Today): "This week: 5 days of class, 10 deadlines, and the HIST 374 Midterm 2 window, Thursday 8 AM to Saturday 11:59 PM. Your study afternoons already cover it." It names nothing to do and moves nothing. The ten deadlines are Sunday Nov 8 HIST and PHYS discussion posts and SPAN homework (11:59 PM tonight), Monday ANTH and ECON quizzes and PHYS homework, Tuesday ECON homework, Wednesday BIO homework, Thursday ANTH discussion post and Friday HIST quiz. She opens the card or she doesn't.
best_fix.why: Looks heavy, is her ordinary week. Her study time is the afternoons: Sunday 1 PM to 3:30 PM (starting in 15 minutes) and a 2 PM block on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, with Tuesday's lab ending at 3:50 PM. Her workouts are Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 7 AM, and Saturday morning is hers. The midterm is a three day window, not a single sitting, and has days of room before it closes. A push would repeat what she can already see, and an extra block would only land on time she keeps free.

must_not: add a Saturday morning study block for the HIST 374 midterm
send a Sunday evening push about the ten deadlines
call the week heavy or tell her to start the midterm early
bring up the two older missing items (HIST 374 Quiz 8 and BIO 418 Homework 9)
move her 7 AM workouts or her afternoon study to make room
write, solve or check any assignment or the midterm
assumptions: Online exam windows in Moodle-style courses open at 8 AM and close at 11:59 PM two days later; HIST 374 Midterm 2 is one of those.
The week check is a card on Today, never a push by itself; a push is only for a catch.
Her two older missing items, from Oct 23 and Oct 28, are already past and are not a pattern to raise on a Sunday.

tempting.suggestion: add a Saturday morning study block for the HIST 374 midterm
tempting.why_wrong: Saturday mornings are hers, and the window leaves Thursday, Friday and Saturday afternoon

tempting.suggestion: send a Sunday evening push about the ten deadlines
tempting.why_wrong: her Sunday evening is the call with her family at 8, and the card already shows the week
